snippet.title: Rushcremental - Official Announcement Trailer
snippet.description:
Announcing that Rushcremental will be coming to Steam on December 19th. Rushcrement is an incremental racing game set in a post-apocalyptic wasteland.

* Relaxing Active Incremental Game
* Explore & Collect Resources
* Upgrade Your Abilities
* Race Challengers
* Idle Resource Collection
* Definitive Ending
